callsigns.title: Callsign directory
callsigns.description: Search Vietnamese amateur radio callsigns recorded from 1991 to 2021.
callsigns.lede: Enter a callsign to look up its recorded license events. This is an archive, not proof of a current authorization.
callsigns.archiveNote: Source: VARC workbook of MIC permit events, 1991–2021. Every dated license in this import has expired. Confirm current status with the licensing authority before operating.
callsigns.detailDescription: {sign} — {name}. Historical Vietnamese amateur radio license record.

ham.qslComingSoon: QSL card design tools are coming soon.

ham.adminPrivateProfileNotice: You are viewing this private profile with administrator access.

map.title: Operator map
map.mapUnavailableHint: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPTILER_API_KEY to enable the map.
map.logbookPrivateNotice: QSO log markers are hidden because this logbook is private.
map.emptyMessage: Add a home grid on your profile or log QSOs with grid locators to see markers.
map.lookupNotFound: No station found for that callsign.
map.homeLocationPromptBody: You have not set a home grid yet. Allow this site to use your device location, then we will save the matching Maidenhead grid and marker on your profile.
map.homeLocationPromptBodyGuest: Allow this site to use your device location so we can show your Maidenhead grid on the map. It is not saved unless you sign in.
map.homeLocationPromptBodyLocate: Allow this site to use your device location so we can place your pin and grid square where you are now. You can choose whether to save it to your profile next.
map.homeLocationPromptBodyUpdate: Your pin is at {grid}. Save this Maidenhead grid and marker to your profile?

map.callsignPromptBody: Your callsign is your public profile address and is required before you can log a QSO.

welcome.title: QSO map
welcome.body: See your station and recent contacts on the map. By default only QSOs from the last 24 hours are shown.

timeFilter.title: Time range
timeFilter.body: Use these chips to change how far back contacts are shown — from minutes to all time.

layers.title: Map layers
layers.body: Toggle grid squares, location pins, great-circle traces, and browser fullscreen.

qsoList.title: QSO logbook
qsoList.body: Open the side list to browse contacts. Select one to focus that grid and path on the map.

pins.title: Grid squares
pins.body: Colored rectangles show 4-character Maidenhead grid fields (for example OL20) around your station and contacts.

locationPin.title: Location pins
locationPin.body: Tap a location pin to open its details — grid square, coordinates, and callsign when shown.

done.title: You’re set
done.body: Open this help button anytime to replay the tour.

qth.title: QTH map
qth.lede: Stations that share their home grid and location publicly.
qth.emptyMessage: When operators share their home grid and location publicly, they appear here.

account.title: Account
account.lede: Manage your profile callsign and upload certificate or license documents.
account.name: Name
account.callsignHelp: Required before logging QSOs. Format check only (e.g. XV1ABC).
account.callsignVerificationMissingDocs: Upload these required documents before requesting verification: {documents}.
account.callsignVerificationReady: Both required documents are available. You can now request verification.
account.homeLocationHelp: Use your device location to fill the grid and coordinates, then adjust either value manually if needed.
account.homeLocationMissing: No GPS coordinates — the map marker will use the grid center.
account.homeLocationCoordsPairRequired: Enter both latitude and longitude, or clear both.
account.homeLocationUnsupported: Geolocation is not available in this browser.
account.homeLocationFailed: Could not get your location. Check browser permissions and try again.
account.securityProfilePublicHelp: Share your name, avatar, callsign, and birthday on your public profile.
account.securityLocationPublicHelp: Share your home grid, map marker, grid rectangle, and address.
account.securityLocationPublicDisabledHelp: Make the profile public first to share location details.
account.securityDocumentsPublicHelp: Allow others to view uploaded certificate and license files on your profile.
account.securityDocumentsPublicDisabledHelp: Make the profile public first to share certificate and license files.
account.securityQsoPublicHelp: Allow other users to view your QSO logbook.
account.securityQsoPublicDisabledHelp: Make the profile public first to allow public QSO logs.
account.securityProfilePrivateNotice: This operator keeps profile details private.
account.securityLocationPrivateNotice: Location details are not shared on this profile.
account.securityQsoPrivateNotice: This operator keeps QSO logs private.
account.securityPasswordCardHelp: Update the password you use to sign in with email. Google sign-in stays available if you linked it.
account.passwordChangeHelp: Enter your current password and choose a new one.
account.passwordSetHelp: Add a password for email sign-in, or enter your existing password if you set one before linking Google.
account.apiTokenCardHelp: Create tokens for external apps and scripts to access your QSO logbook via the REST API.
account.apiTokenCreateHelp: Give the token a name so you can recognize it later. The secret is shown only once.
account.apiTokenCreatedWarning: Copy this token now. You will not be able to see it again.
account.setupLede: Add your callsign and grid location to publish your operator profile. You can still manage account settings here.
account.callsignRequired: Set your callsign below before you can use the logbook.
